name: cedarloom
description: CedarLoom: the cl-workflow, cl-repo and cl-orchestration plugins for Claude Code and Codex, and the cedarloom bundle that installs all three.

plugins.name: cedarloom
plugins.description: Installs the CedarLoom plugins cl-workflow, cl-repo and cl-orchestration together.

plugins.name: cl-workflow
plugins.description: Chooses how much checking a task gets (a software change, a docs pass or research) and starts the planning, review and research agents it needs.

plugins.name: cl-repo
plugins.description: Sets up and maintains a repository: its agent setup, audits, fixes and maintenance passes.

plugins.name: cl-orchestration
plugins.description: Coordinates the issues of several projects from one session: worker jobs, reviews and merge checks. Installs cl-workflow with it.
